timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Greetings. I apologize to interrupt your television program, but we have an important announcement.
We wish to claim this out of ringed planet, so we can establish a more advanced and respectable
society. We take it that you will refuse to leave, so negotiation is not an option.
We come from a world far, far away. We don't make threats, we make promises and we keep promises.
All we've ever done where we come from is a act and survive. I'm sure none of you know what that
means, so I'll speak in a language you understand. We promise that if you refuse to leave,
we will get rid of you one way or another. You will be but a small inconvenience.
We know you've all been very busy building yourself your own communities. You feel secure behind
the safety of your walls, your highly advanced tourists and other sorts of shiny toys. I'm
personally impressed by your resourcefulness, but it's time we step in and present to your
own nations. We avoid. We are this world, reckoning. You won't have to look for it. We choose when
and where we will meet. I can assure you we are nothing like you've ever faced before. That is all.

youtube_description:
A long forgotten group, only known to those who faced them in their world and those who have the technology to venture through the history of their long lost planet. What horrors do they bring from Fairview, to the outer rim?

Violence, Omnipotence, Impromptu and Destruction.

_______________

This is a mod trailer for an upcoming faction mod in RimWorld, a faction dear to me that has long vanished from Dead Frontier, they're known as VOID. We'll be fighting them with their arsenal from Fairview soon.
